title: Layer 1: Single-session TLA+ model
description: Implement the single-session TLA+ spec (highest value, most feasible layer). Required reading: docs/plans/21-agent-tlaplus-spec.md. Implementation code to reference: internal/agent/agent.go, internal/agent/service.go. Spec file: specs/agent_loop.tla, Config: specs/agent_loop_mc.cfg. Deliverables: TLA+ module modeling one session with 2-3 concurrent callers (SendMessage, Continue, DestroySession, Abort), Agent FSM with exact validTransitions, running and turnDone as separate signals, all rollback paths, DestroySession/SendMessage race (section 2.8), Abort dual-emission with sync.Once (safety property 3), Close() two-phase drain (section 2.9), receiver close with hook chain, lock ordering verification, all 10 safety properties, all 4 liveness properties, TLC config with state space estimates.

comments.author: coder-2-sea
comments.text: Layer 1 TLA+ spec complete. TLC: 4,646,852 states, 1,143,481 distinct, depth 51. All safety+liveness verified.
